# Models of the bought parts

The checks and the renders place the makers' 3D models of two boards. They are not ours to share: download them here.

| File | From |
|---|---|
| `ws_amoled18/ESP32-S3-Touch-AMOLED-1.8-3D.stp` | Waveshare, [ESP32-S3-Touch-AMOLED-1.8 wiki](https://www.waveshare.com/wiki/ESP32-S3-Touch-AMOLED-1.8), Resources, 3D drawing |
| `as7341.step` | Adafruit, [Adafruit_CAD_Parts](https://github.com/adafruit/Adafruit_CAD_Parts), 4698 AS7341 |

The encoder and the battery are drawn in `cad/m2.py` from their datasheet dimensions.
